class Extension<   string TargetFeatureName,   string Spelling,   string ArchitectureFeatureName,   string Desc,   list<SubtargetFeature> Implies = [] > : SubtargetFeature<TargetFeatureName, "Has" # Spelling, "true", Desc, Implies> {
    string ArchExtKindSpelling = "AEK_" # Spelling;
    string ArchFeatureName = ArchitectureFeatureName;
    string UserVisibleName = "";
    string UserVisibleAlias = "";
}
class ExtensionWithMArch<   string TargetFeatureName,   string Spelling,   string ArchitectureFeatureName,   string Desc,   list<SubtargetFeature> Implies = [] > : Extension<TargetFeatureName, Spelling, ArchitectureFeatureName, Desc, Implies> {
    let UserVisibleName = TargetFeatureName;
}

class AArch64Inst<Format f, string cstr> : Instruction {
  field bits<32> Inst;
  field bits<32> Unpredictable = 0;
  field bits<32> SoftFail = Unpredictable;
  let Namespace   = "AArch64";
  Format F        = f;
  bits<2> Form    = F.Value;
  bit isWhile = 0;
  bit isPTestLike = 0;
  FalseLanesEnum FalseLanes = FalseLanesNone;
  DestructiveInstTypeEnum DestructiveInstType = NotDestructive;
  SMEMatrixTypeEnum SMEMatrixType = SMEMatrixNone;
  ElementSizeEnum ElementSize = ElementSizeNone;
  let TSFlags{13-11} = SMEMatrixType.Value;
  let TSFlags{10}    = isPTestLike;
  let TSFlags{9}     = isWhile;
  let TSFlags{8-7}   = FalseLanes.Value;
  let TSFlags{6-3}   = DestructiveInstType.Value;
  let TSFlags{2-0}   = ElementSize.Value;
  let Pattern       = [];
  let Constraints   = cstr;
}
class InstSubst<string Asm, dag Result, bit EmitPriority = 0>   : InstAlias<Asm, Result, EmitPriority>, Requires<[UseNegativeImmediates]>;
class Pseudo<dag oops, dag iops, list<dag> pattern, string cstr = "">     : AArch64Inst<PseudoFrm, cstr> {
  dag OutOperandList = oops;
  dag InOperandList  = iops;
  let Pattern        = pattern;
  let isCodeGenOnly  = 1;
  let isPseudo       = 1;
}
class EncodedI<string cstr, list<dag> pattern> : AArch64Inst<NormalFrm, cstr> {
  let Pattern = pattern;
  let Size = 4;
}
class I<dag oops, dag iops, string asm, string operands, string cstr,         list<dag> pattern>     : EncodedI<cstr, pattern> {
  dag OutOperandList = oops;
  dag InOperandList  = iops;
  let AsmString      = !strconcat(asm, operands);
}

multiclass masked_gather_scatter<PatFrags GatherScatterOp> {
  def NAME#_signed_scaled :     PatFrag<(ops node:$val, node:$pred, node:$ptr, node:$idx),             (GatherScatterOp node:$val, node:$pred, node:$ptr, node:$idx),[{
    auto MGS = cast<MaskedGatherScatterSDNode>(N);
    bool Signed = MGS->isIndexSigned() ||         MGS->getIndex().getValueType().getVectorElementType() == MVT::i64;
    return Signed && MGS->isIndexScaled();
  }]>;
  def NAME#_signed_unscaled :     PatFrag<(ops node:$val, node:$pred, node:$ptr, node:$idx),             (GatherScatterOp node:$val, node:$pred, node:$ptr, node:$idx),[{
    auto MGS = cast<MaskedGatherScatterSDNode>(N);
    bool Signed = MGS->isIndexSigned() ||         MGS->getIndex().getValueType().getVectorElementType() == MVT::i64;
    return Signed && !MGS->isIndexScaled();
  }]>;
  def NAME#_unsigned_scaled :     PatFrag<(ops node:$val, node:$pred, node:$ptr, node:$idx),             (GatherScatterOp node:$val, node:$pred, node:$ptr, node:$idx),[{
    auto MGS = cast<MaskedGatherScatterSDNode>(N);
    bool Signed = MGS->isIndexSigned() ||         MGS->getIndex().getValueType().getVectorElementType() == MVT::i64;
    return !Signed && MGS->isIndexScaled();
  }]>;
  def NAME#_unsigned_unscaled :     PatFrag<(ops node:$val, node:$pred, node:$ptr, node:$idx),             (GatherScatterOp node:$val, node:$pred, node:$ptr, node:$idx),[{
    auto MGS = cast<MaskedGatherScatterSDNode>(N);
    bool Signed = MGS->isIndexSigned() ||         MGS->getIndex().getValueType().getVectorElementType() == MVT::i64;
    return !Signed && !MGS->isIndexScaled();
  }]>;
}

def alignedglobal : PatLeaf<(iPTR iPTR:$label), [{
  if (auto *G = dyn_cast<GlobalAddressSDNode>(N)) {
    const DataLayout &DL = MF->getDataLayout();
    Align Align = G->getGlobal()->getPointerAlignment(DL);
    return Align >= 4 && G->getOffset() % 4 == 0;
  }
  if (auto *C = dyn_cast<ConstantPoolSDNode>(N))     return C->getAlign() >= 4 && C->getOffset() % 4 == 0;
  return false;
}]>;

/* Aliases for when offset=0. Note that in contrast to LoadAcquire which has a $Rn of type GPR64sp0, we deliberately choose to make $Rn of type GPR64sp and add an alias for the case of immediate #0. This is because new STLR versions (from LRCPC3 extension) do have a non-zero immediate value, so GPR64sp0 is not appropriate anymore (it parses and discards the optional zero). This is not the case for LoadAcquire because the new LRCPC3 LDAR instructions are post-indexed, and the immediate values are not inside the [] brackets and thus not accepted by GPR64sp0 parser. */ def STLRW0  : InstAlias<"stlr\t$Rt, [$Rn, #0]" , (STLRW   GPR32: $Rt, GPR64sp:$Rn)>;
def STLRX0  : InstAlias<"stlr\t$Rt, [$Rn, #0]" , (STLRX   GPR64: $Rt, GPR64sp:$Rn)>;

def CycloneModel : SchedMachineModel {
  let IssueWidth = 6;
  let MicroOpBufferSize = 192;
  let LoadLatency = 4;
  let MispredictPenalty = 16;
  let CompleteModel = 1;
  list<Predicate> UnsupportedFeatures = !listconcat(SVEUnsupported.F,                                                     PAUnsupported.F,                                                     SMEUnsupported.F,                                                     [HasMTE, HasCSSC, HasMOPS, HasMOPS_GO]);
}

def ExynosM3Model : SchedMachineModel {
  let IssueWidth            =   6;
  let MicroOpBufferSize     = 228;
  let LoopMicroOpBufferSize =  40;
  let LoadLatency           =   4;
  let MispredictPenalty     =  16;
  let CompleteModel         =   1;
  list<Predicate> UnsupportedFeatures = !listconcat(SVEUnsupported.F,                                                     PAUnsupported.F,                                                     SMEUnsupported.F,                                                     [HasMTE, HasCSSC, HasMOPS, HasMOPS_GO]);
}

def ExynosM4Model : SchedMachineModel {
  let IssueWidth            =   6;
  let MicroOpBufferSize     = 228;
  let LoopMicroOpBufferSize =  48;
  let LoadLatency           =   4;
  let MispredictPenalty     =  16;
  let CompleteModel         =   1;
  list<Predicate> UnsupportedFeatures = !listconcat(SVEUnsupported.F,                                                     PAUnsupported.F,                                                     SMEUnsupported.F,                                                     [HasMTE, HasCSSC, HasMOPS, HasMOPS_GO]);
}

}

}

class TLBICommon<string name, bits<3> op1, bits<4> crm, bits<3> op2, bit nxs,                  RegValue reguse> {
  string Name = name;
  bits<14> Encoding;
  RegValue RegUse = reguse;
  let Encoding{13-11} = op1;
  let Encoding{10-8} = 0b100;
  let Encoding{7} = nxs;
  let Encoding{6-3} = crm;
  let Encoding{2-0} = op2;
  list<string> Requires = [];
  list<string> ExtraRequires = [];
  code RequiresStr = [{ { }] # !interleave(Requires # ExtraRequires, [{, }]) # [{ } }];
}
class TLBIEntry<string name, bits<3> op1, bits<4> crm, bits<3> op2, bit nxs,                 RegValue reguse>   : TLBICommon<name, op1, crm, op2, nxs, reguse>;
class TLBIPEntry<string name, bits<3> op1, bits<4> crm, bits<3> op2, bit nxs,                  RegValue reguse>   : TLBICommon<name, op1, crm, op2, nxs, reguse> {
  bit AllowWithTLBID = !match(name, ".*E[12][IO]S.*");
}
multiclass TLBITableBase<list<string> fields> {
  def NAME # Table : GenericTable {
    let FilterClass = NAME # "Entry";
    let CppTypeName = NAME;
    let Fields = fields;
    string TypeOf_RegUse = "SysAliasRegUse";
    let PrimaryKey = ["Encoding"];
    let PrimaryKeyName = "lookup" # NAME # "ByEncoding";
  }
  def lookup # NAME # ByName : SearchIndex {
    let Table = !cast<GenericTable>(NAME # "Table");
    let Key = ["Name"];
  }
}

class GIC<string name, bits<3> op1, bits<4> crn, bits<4> crm, bits<3> op2, bit needsreg = 1> {
  string Name = name;
  bits<14> Encoding;
  let Encoding{13-11} = op1;
  let Encoding{10-7} = crn;
  let Encoding{6-3} = crm;
  let Encoding{2-0} = op2;
  bit NeedsReg = needsreg;
  string RequiresStr = [{ {AArch64::FeatureGCIE} }];
}
class GSB<string name, bits<3> op1, bits<4> crn, bits<4> crm, bits<3> op2> {
  string Name = name;
  bits<14> Encoding;
  let Encoding{13-11} = op1;
  let Encoding{10-7} = crn;
  let Encoding{6-3} = crm;
  let Encoding{2-0} = op2;
  string RequiresStr = [{ {AArch64::FeatureGCIE} }];
}
class GICR<string name, bits<3> op1, bits<4> crn, bits<4> crm, bits<3> op2> {
  string Name = name;
  bits<14> Encoding;
  let Encoding{13-11} = op1;
  let Encoding{10-7} = crn;
  let Encoding{6-3} = crm;
  let Encoding{2-0} = op2;
  bit NeedsReg = 1;
  string RequiresStr = [{ {AArch64::FeatureGCIE} }];
}

  let FilterClass = "GIC";

  let PrimaryKey = ["Encoding"];

class PLBIEntry<bits<3> op1, bits<4> crn, bits<4> crm, bits<3> op2, string name,                 RegValue reguse> {
  string Name = name;
  bits<14> Encoding;
  RegValue RegUse = reguse;
  let Encoding{13-11} = op1;
  let Encoding{10-7} = crn;
  let Encoding{6-3} = crm;
  let Encoding{2-0} = op2;
  string RequiresStr = [{ {AArch64::FeatureS1POE2} }];
}
def PLBITable : GenericTable {
  let FilterClass = "PLBIEntry";
  let CppTypeName = "PLBI";
  let Fields = ["Name", "Encoding", "RegUse", "RequiresStr"];
  string TypeOf_RegUse = "SysAliasRegUse";
  let PrimaryKey = ["Encoding"];
  let PrimaryKeyName = "lookupPLBIByEncoding";
}
def lookupPLBIByName : SearchIndex {
  let Table = PLBITable;
  let Key = ["Name"];
}

  bits<4> Zn;
  let Inst{31-24} = 0b01100101;
  let Inst{23-22} = size;
  let Inst{21-11} = 0b00110100110;
  let Inst{10}    = U;
  let Inst{9-6}   = Zn;
  let Inst{5}     = 0b0;
  let Inst{4-0}   = Zd;
}
multiclass sve2_fp_to_int_downcvt<string asm, bit U, SDPatternOperator op> {
  def _HtoB : sve2_fp_to_int_downcvt<asm, ZPR8,  ZZ_h_mul_r, 0b01, U>;
  def _StoH : sve2_fp_to_int_downcvt<asm, ZPR16, ZZ_s_mul_r, 0b10, U>;
  def _DtoS : sve2_fp_to_int_downcvt<asm, ZPR32, ZZ_d_mul_r, 0b11, U>;
  def: SVE_Cvt_VG2_Pat<NAME # _HtoB, op, nxv16i8, nxv8f16>;
  def: SVE_Cvt_VG2_Pat<NAME # _StoH, op, nxv8i16, nxv4f32>;
  def: SVE_Cvt_VG2_Pat<NAME # _DtoS, op, nxv4i32, nxv2f64>;
}
class sve2_int_to_fp_upcvt<string asm, ZPRRegOp ZdRC, ZPRRegOp ZnRC,                         bits<2> size, bits<2> U>   : I<(outs ZdRC:$Zd), (ins  ZnRC:$Zn),       asm, "\t$Zd, $Zn", "", []>, Sched<[]> {
  bits<5> Zd;
  bits<5> Zn;
  let Inst{31-24} = 0b01100101;
  let Inst{23-22} = size;
  let Inst{21-12} = 0b0011000011;
  let Inst{11-10} = U;
  let Inst{9-5}   = Zn;
  let Inst{4-0}   = Zd;
}
multiclass sve2_int_to_fp_upcvt<string asm, bits<2> U, SDPatternOperator op> {
  def _BtoH : sve2_int_to_fp_upcvt<asm, ZPR16, ZPR8,  0b01, U>;
  def _HtoS : sve2_int_to_fp_upcvt<asm, ZPR32, ZPR16, 0b10, U>;
  def _StoD : sve2_int_to_fp_upcvt<asm, ZPR64, ZPR32, 0b11, U>;
  def : SVE_1_Op_Pat<nxv8f16, op, nxv16i8, !cast<Instruction>(NAME # _BtoH)>;
  def : SVE_1_Op_Pat<nxv4f32, op, nxv8i16, !cast<Instruction>(NAME # _HtoS)>;
  def : SVE_1_Op_Pat<nxv2f64, op, nxv4i32, !cast<Instruction>(NAME # _StoD)>;
}
